# Sika

> > Global leader in specialty chemicals for construction and industry, offering bonding, sealing, waterproofing, concrete, and flooring solutions.

Sika Group is a multinational specialty chemicals company founded by Kaspar Winkler, known for its construction solutions including Sikaflex adhesives, SikaWrap FRP systems, Sikafloor seamless flooring, and sustainable building technologies. The company operates globally with a strong corporate culture called the Sika Spirit.

## Key Topics

- Specialty Chemicals
- Construction Solutions
- Floor Systems
- Bonding & Sealing
- Waterproofing Systems

## Construction Solutions

- [Construction Solutions](https://www.sika.com/en/construction.html): Construction solutions: waterproofing, concrete, roofing & floor systems
- [Construction Adhesives](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/construction-adhesives.html): Sikaflex & SikaBond construction adhesives for structural bonding
- [Concrete Repair](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/concrete-repair.html): Concrete repair & structural rehabilitation solutions per ICRI standards
- [Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) Fabrics](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/structural-strengthening/fiber-reinforced-polymer-fabrics.html): SikaWrap FRP carbon & glass fiber fabrics for structural strengthening
- [Bridge Deck Waterproofing](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/waterproofing-systems/bridge-deck.html): Bridge deck waterproofing with bitumen, hot spray & cementitious systems

## Floor Systems & Flooring Solutions

- [Floor Systems](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/floor-systems.html): Seamless floor systems using epoxy, PMMA & hybrid technologies
- [Concrete Flooring](https://www.sika.com/en/construction/floor-systems/concrete-flooring.html): Sikafloor concrete flooring with Sikament admixtures & EpoCem systems
- [Seamless, Stylish Resin Flooring with Sika ComfortFloor®](https://www.sika.com/en/brands/comfortfloor.html): Sika ComfortFloor polyurethane seamless flooring systems
